title: The affected products use an unprotected firmware-update channel, which may allow for unauthorized… (CVE-2026-124281)
description: This vulnerability involves an unprotected firmware-update channel in certain products, allowing unauthorized modification of firmware. The flaw could enable attackers to alter firmware without proper authorization, potentially impacting system integrity and availability. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 6.1, indicating a medium severity level. No specific affected versions or patch information are provided.
